actions.title: Autonomous Objective Formulation

assumptions: Function estimation is sufficient for successful goal inference.
Locally-linear learning captures the essential dynamics of interaction.
Interaction histories contain implicit objective signals sufficient for convergence.
definition.falsification: Agents consistently fail to converge to stable objective-like functions across diverse interaction datasets, showing no objective-like persistence.
definition.statement: Autonomous systems utilizing locally-linear learning formulations for function estimation can successfully derive coherent, persistent objectives from interaction histories.
definition.uncertainty: The length of interaction required to stabilize an objective and the impact of initial noise remain unknown.
